verdict.rationale: mParticle's first-party docs include a 'Client SDKs' section and a 'Send your first event to mParticle' guide, so official SDKs exist as a documented offering. The pack gives only section titles, though, with no detail on languages, platforms, or depth. Missing for 10: the list of supported platforms and languages, SDK API reference depth, installation and usage detail, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building against the SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
